title: Autumn Apple Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad made with crisp apple, juicy greens, and sweet notes from the dressing.

ingredients.name: juicy greens
ingredients.notes: such as mixed greens or arugula

ingredients.name: salad
ingredients.notes: such as shredded carrot and sliced cucumber

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the juicy greens and salad.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar and maple syrup to make the dressing.
3. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
4. Slice the sweet apple into thin wedges and arrange on top of the salad.
